target_customer: Developer tool and AI infrastructure companies that want to be discovered and used by AI agents
problem: AI coding agents now choose which tools developers use, and companies have no visibility into or strategy for how agents recommend them.
business_model: Services retainers for strategy, docs, content and distribution plus agent visibility tracking software
product_category: Agent relations (DevRel and generative engine optimization for AI agents)

founders.name: Naman Bansal
prior_employers: Fractional DevRel work for overseas tech companies since age 13 (self-reported)
previous_startups: manicule.dev earlier DevRel work; earlier startups with Jain including a recruiting agency (Fondo podcast summary)
founders.background_notes: Grew up in Agra, India per Grit Daily.

founders.name: Shreyans Jain
education: High school graduate; skipped college (YC bio, Grit Daily)
founders.background_notes: Started building at 14; YC bio lists age 19, so sources differ.

competitors.name: Peec AI
competitors.what: AI search visibility tracking for brands
competitors.traction_then: raised a 7M EUR seed in July 2025 per a Dealroom chart page

competitors.name: Profound
competitors.what: Answer engine optimization platform, often called category leader

technical_complexity.rationale: Visibility tracking and content services are standard engineering; the difficulty is knowing what makes agents recommend a product.

defensibility.rationale: Service heavy with an open source docs framework and trackable metrics that tracking competitors also offer; relationships with early customers are the main asset.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: GEO suites from SEO incumbents exist; none found offering the full services model.

market_need_then: Developer tool firms report agents influencing tool choice; Grit Daily and the site cite a Supermemory case study claiming 90 percent more traffic in three months (company claim).

branding.domain_note: Owns manicule.com per its site; earlier work used manicule.dev.

identity.logo: not described by any source found
identity.visual_style: Not assessed beyond short punchy copy
identity.voice_and_tone: Short punchy headlines and fragments such as Found. Chosen. Used.

branding.brand_signature: AgentRel as a coined category name
branding.community_and_virality: Teen founder story drew coverage in Grit Daily and American Bazaar; founders appeared on the Fondo START podcast.

brand_strength.rationale: The category term AgentRel is memorable but the company name is unusual to spell and inconsistently paired with AgentRel in coverage.

outcome_analysis: Manicule is an active Spring 2026 company that raised a 1.3 million dollar seed in October 2026 and lists named developer tool customers. Founder fit is strong because both founders did DevRel and startup engineering early, but the model is service heavy and overlaps with funded visibility trackers, so scaling beyond founder led delivery is the main test.
notes: Seed round reported by Grit Daily, SignalBase and American Bazaar (about 2026-10-27 to 30); stage labeled seed by those sources. Founder age conflict: articles say 18, YC bio says Jain is 19; ages are from the article, not a birth year. Customer lists differ between the site and the press. Name origin not explained by any source. Competitor dates for Profound come from an article updated July 2026, after founding. Outcome search found no shutdown or acquisition.
